scripts.prepare:web: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true}); for(const f of ['index.html','style.css','app.js','manifest.json','sw.js']) fs.copyFileSync(f,'www/'+f); fs.cpSync('icons','www/icons',{recursive:true});"
scripts.build:android: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android
